title: decree schema --format json
description: What `decree schema --format json` prints on stdout: the files it wrote into .decree/schema/ and the files it removed from there. Reference: docs/reference/cli.md, Machine-readable output.

written.description: Paths written, relative to the project root (.decree/schema/…), in order; text prints these.

removed.description: Paths removed from .decree/schema/ because decree no longer writes them, relative to the project root.
